concern_summary: This concern covers the display and management of money requests, including their status, potential violations, user interactions, and relevant UI elements based on the money request context.
This concern involves the validation and management of monetary amounts in money requests, ensuring correct input and formatting before submission.
This concern focuses on the user interface interactions related to processing holds on money requests, including confirmations.
This concern manages the confirmation and processing of money requests, including handling payment options and approval workflows.
This concern handles the logic for managing the editability of money requests based on user permissions and request status.
This concern focuses on providing options for initiating money requests, including various types of requests like splitting expenses, submitting expenses, and tracking expenses.
This concern deals with validating and rendering money request reports based on specific criteria related to their status and existence.
This concern involves the deletion and cleanup processes for money requests, ensuring associated transaction data and reports are updated accordingly.
